title: Companies with Measures to Deal with Workplace Harassment
what_it_is: Companies with Measures to Deal with Workplace Harassment

sections.label: TAFEP workplace harassment centre
sections.summary: MOM announced two months ago that TAFEP would set up a centre for workplace harassment to enhance support for individuals reporting it.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: At the Ministry of Manpower's (MOM's) Committee of Supply (COS) debate this year, in fact, just two months ago, we announced that TAFEP would set up a centre for workplace harassment, so as to further enhance the support provided to individuals who come forward to report workplace harassment.

sections.label: Tripartite advisories and grievance procedures
sections.summary: Tripartite advisories give guidance; MOM and TAFEP assess whether employers implemented effective grievance handling and advisory measures when evaluating harassment complaints.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Tripartite advisories are meant to provide further guidance for employers and employees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We do not track how many companies implement the measures suggested in the advisories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: However, when evaluating whether an employer has taken adequate measures in response to a complaint of workplace harassment, MOM and TAFEP will assess whether the employer has implemented an effective grievance handling procedure as well as the measures that are outlined in the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Workplace Harassment.

sections.label: MOM action against egregious companies
sections.summary: For egregious cases where companies fail to provide a safe environment, MOM will take actions including curtailing work passes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For egregious cases where the companies fail to provide a safe environment for their employees, MOM will take actions against the company, including curtailing the work passes.

sections.label: Request to review harassment advisory
sections.summary: A request asks MOM to lead and work with tripartite partners to review the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Workplace Harassment and outreach efforts and materials.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: In light of the amendments that she has seen in the last two days on the Penal Code as well as POHA, can I request MOM to take the lead and work with our tripartite partners and review the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Workplace Harassment as well as the outreach efforts and materials?

sections.label: TAFEP Resource Centre operations
sections.summary: After its early March announcement at MOM COS, the TAFEP Resource Centre began operations, letting employees report and be advised on actions and support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As soon as it was announced in early March during the MOM COS, the Resource Centre at TAFEP began its operations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Employees can choose to file the report with TAFEP and they will be advised on the appropriate actions that they can take against the perpetrator and also the avenues of support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Depending on the case details, TAFEP can link them up with the Police, or the Courts if it is an egregious case of workplace harassment which constitutes an offence under the Penal Code or POHA.
